list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; 0 online trophies.

source_labels.exophase: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)
source_labels.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress targets)
source_labels.powerpyx: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_reason: It pops automatically once the other 54 are earned; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. There is no online or DLC requirement: all 54 are single-player and offline. It is the last trophy you will earn, so treat the roadmap as the route to it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. Just play the story and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on finishing the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 and it unlocks as the story moves on to Chapter 2. There is nothing extra to do — play through the chapter's missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on finishing the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 and it unlocks as Chapter 3 begins. Play through the chapter's missions and it comes automatically.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on finishing the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks as the story moves on. Play through the chapter's missions and it comes automatically.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on finishing the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it unlocks as the story moves into its final stretch. Play through the chapter's missions and it comes automatically.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on finishing the final mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final mission of the story and it unlocks at the credits. There is no mission replay in the game, so keep a manual save at the start of the final chapter (the game offers 15 manual save slots) in case you ever want to revisit the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_reason: Story trophy, automatic on completing the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory, late in the story. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_reason: Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable; everything on it stays doable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy in the set. The 100% Completion checklist opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: most side quests are not needed and collectibles are only partly required. Work through the checklist after the story and this pops; it is the last big job before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_reason: Stunts stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely; under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and completed stunts stay marked on the map. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missable_reason: Activities stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them in Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon). Most unlock naturally while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missable_reason: Shooting ranges stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 ranges. The gold thresholds are not very hard: take your time, use a steady weapon, and retry a challenge until the gold score clears. This is also required in full for the 100% checklist, so it has to be done properly either way.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missable_reason: Drone races stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total across them). You only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's racing line, win once, and move on to the next location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missable_reason: Races stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race locations count, so spread your wins across locations instead of repeating one race. Road races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the racing activity, but the trophy counts 20 different race wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_reason: Cal's questline stays available after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are also one of the 9 activity types, so this feeds Master of None too.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missable_reason: The arcade games stay playable after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of a game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_reason: Andy's quests stay available after the story; nothing about the questline can be missed.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and is marked automatically in Chapter 3. Wait for Andy's call, then her text with her home address in Belville, and work through her five quests: the Cellerica chain — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_reason: Kenton returns after his Chapter 1 absence and his quests stay available after the story; nothing about the questline can be missed.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Track it in Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_reason: Billy's quests stay available after the story; nothing about the questline can be missed.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being mapped. Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story; track progress in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_reason: Randy's wish list stays available after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wish list, steal them, and deliver in good condition for better pay. Track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_reason: Tyrone's quests stay available after the story; nothing about the questline can be missed.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone offers Spin On This to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Potentially missable — the only one in the set. One meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. PowerPyx (18 Nov 2026) flags it as the single possibly missable trophy; whether it counts toward the trophy is still unconfirmed, so do it while you can.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track it in Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to meditate. That house meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it while you can. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_reason: Bret's questline stays available after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about meeting him in Lummox County. Do his first quest, Veteran Hunted; he then marks hunting spots on the map, and you bring the animals he requests back to him. He gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest. Still available after the story, and his 15 Target Decks are part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missable_reason: Cards stay collectible in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a collectible type with 18 sets around Leonida; finish any three sets. Pick the three easiest sets and collect them with a card-set location guide rather than wandering.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missable_reason: WAiNK scan spots stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more — so scan whatever you pass instead of hunting a fixed list. Scanning vehicles with the same app also feeds other trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missable_reason: Challenges stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there. View challenges in Progress, then Challenges; pick the easiest ones and leave the hardest 10 undone. Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies and the 100% requirements.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Partner play stays available after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. It unlocks after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape in a fast bike; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because cops and helicopters struggle to follow there. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone. You will likely earn it naturally during the bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Shop robberies stay available after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time and loot three robbery targets in a row — the three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) unlocks them. Bring armor, sticky bombs and healing; the pop is delayed about half a minute after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missable_reason: Vehicles stay scannable in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) and scan every new vehicle you see — standing on a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest way. You only need to scan them, not drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes automatically. Check discovered vehicles in Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missable_reason: Combat Focus can be used anywhere in free-roam after it unlocks; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming; time slows and weak points are highlighted. It lasts only a few seconds, so buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up, Adrenaline to extend it) and line up five enemies — gang-operation members work well; it does not seem to count on soldiers, police or civilians. Wear body armor and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: The airport and its planes stay accessible in free-roam after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to enter, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_reason: The air base and its tanks stay accessible in free-roam after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino). They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot until the trophy unlocks. Expect a 3-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_reason: Jewelry-store robberies stay available after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3), which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry-store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missable_reason: Bank-vault robberies stay available after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each (finish his Payday Loans jobs first). Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to lose the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_reason: Armored trucks keep driving around Vice City after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts: tailing the truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as an armored-truck robbery. You can also do it earlier by blocking an armored truck near a bank, sticking a bomb on its back door, and escaping the red heat radius afterwards. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missable_reason: The map stays explorable in free-roam after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — all 52 regions. The fastest way is to fly a plane over every fogged area until the whole map is visible. Check progress on the map itself; any black fog left means a region is still unexplored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missable_reason: Illegal operations stay available in free-roam after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked from story progress. Track per-gang counts in Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_reason: No published guide has pinned down its trigger yet, so no missable window can be stated; it is a location moment on Ocean Beach, not a story gate.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. As of 18 Nov 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description points to a specific moment on Ocean Beach, so try the beach bars and viewpoints as you pass through the area during the story, and check back once guides update.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: The showroom and the Banshee stay accessible after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable_reason: Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for what is left.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable — if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for what is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Gyms stay open in free-roam after the story; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength in Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then select a character. It only becomes possible after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch between them. Raise strength by working out — buy a gym membership and always train together (call your partner with Right + Triangle; while one trains, the other progresses too). Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Profile actions can be done at any time in free-roam; the counter never locks. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile, which only makes cops more aggressive.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Profile actions range from stealthy clean robberies (Professional) to killing (Violent, Psycho); the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes cops more aggressive, so avoid excessive violence if you can. This happens passively across robberies and fights — if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Track the 0/500 count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: No published guide has pinned down its trigger yet, so no missable window can be stated.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. As of 18 Nov 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Try replaying the Payday Loans robbery beats and watch for a second-attempt moment; check back once guides update.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: No published guide has pinned down its trigger yet, so no missable window can be stated.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? As of 18 Nov 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. Keep an eye out for strange lights and unexplained events while exploring, especially at night, and check back once guides update.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_reason: No published guide has pinned down its trigger yet, so no missable window can be stated.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. As of 18 Nov 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to involve kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try melee attacks from a moving bike; check back once guides update.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missable_reason: Laundering stays available after the story; the total is cumulative across robberies.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery (unlocked after That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4), so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missable_reason: Shops stay open after the story; spending is cumulative and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they are the fastest way to reach the total. Shops of every kind count: mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, Ammu-Nations, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, tattoo studios and electronics stores. This total builds passively across a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missable_reason: Garages stay purchasable after the story; nothing about them can be missed.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 to 4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missable_reason: Registration stays available after the story, once you own enough garage space.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
